svg.title: Faster R-CNN MobileNet N/S family
svg.desc: Variable canvas H and proposal limit K are tabulated below. COCO: 91 internal slots mapped to 80 classes. R and N are data-dependent counts.
svg.text: Variable canvas H and proposal limit K are tabulated below. COCO: 91 internal slots mapped to 80 classes. R and N are data-dependent counts.

g.data-description: Bilinear resize. Min/max edge from N/S table
Pad right/bottom to multiple of 32. Canvas unchanged for the selected square input
g.text: Canvas unchanged for the selected square input

g.data-description: 1: IR 3×3, s=1 +; expand 16. 16 input; 16 × H/2 × H/2
2: IR 3×3, s=2; expand 64. 16 input; 24 × H/4 × H/4
3: IR 3×3, s=1 +; expand 72. 24 input; 24 × H/4 × H/4
4: IR 5×5, s=2; expand 72; SE 24. 24 input; 40 × H/8 × H/8

g.text: Blocks 1...6 use ReLU; blocks 7...15 and stem/final use Hardswish.
RPN receives 3 feature maps. RoIAlign excludes the extra pooled map.
FPN normalization: none; all FPN convs have bias.
Both M13 and M16 outputs have stride 32; resize preserves the grid.
The selected RoI feature level range is 5...5.

g.data-description: Each FPN feature independently. 256 channels; shared RPN weights
Conv2d 3×3 + ReLU. 256 channels; repeat 1; no norm
Top-K per level, then sigmoid. K pre-NMS proposals per level
Flatten anchor rows. Weights for box delta decode: 1,1,1,1
Generate anchors. 15 per location; all five sizes on each level
g.text: 15 per location; all five sizes on each level

g.data-description: Decode anchor-relative deltas. Center shift; exp sizes; clip log-scale
g.text: Center shift; exp sizes; clip log-scale

g.data-description: Filter proposals and level-wise NMS. score ≥ 0.05; NMS IoU 0.7
Retain at most K proposals. R × 4 boxes; R varies with image values
g.text: R × 4 boxes; R varies with image values
Raw anchor rows from N/S table.
Clip to canvas; remove boxes smaller than 0.001 pixels.
Box RoI head and final detection selection

g.data-description: Softmax across 91 slots. Drop background slot 0
Decode against proposals. Box coder weights 10,10,5,5; clip to canvas
g.text: Box coder weights 10,10,5,5; clip to canvas

g.aria-label: Score > 0.05; remove tiny boxes; class NMS 0.5; top 100
g.data-label: Score > 0.05; remove tiny boxes; class NMS 0.5; top 100
g.data-description: Score > 0.05; remove tiny boxes; class NMS 0.5; top 100. N ≤100 boxes, labels and scores; invert input resize
g.text: Score > 0.05; remove tiny boxes; class NMS 0.5; top 100
N ≤100 boxes, labels and scores; invert input resize
R and N are dynamic. Their upper limits are fixed:
R ≤K and N ≤100. All per-RoI dimensions are resolved.
Model outputs use 91-class IDs; the library maps valid COCO IDs to 80.

g.data-description: Flatten spatial features. 12544 values; skip for second FC

g.text: Exact input, expanded and output widths are on each stage.

g.data-description: Input. Residual only at stages marked +
Optional Conv2d 1×1. Skipped only in block 1; expanded width from stage
g.text: Skipped only in block 1; expanded width from stage

g.data-description: FrozenBatchNorm2d + activation. eps=0.00001; ReLU or Hardswish from stage
g.text: eps=0.00001; ReLU or Hardswish from stage

g.data-description: Depthwise Conv2d. k/stride from stage; groups = expanded channels
g.text: k/stride from stage; groups = expanded channels

g.data-description: Optional SqueezeExcitation. Present when stage gives SE width
g.text: Present when stage gives SE width

g.data-description: Conv2d 1×1 projection. Output width from stage; no activation
g.text: Output width from stage; no activation
Other stages return the projection normalization directly.
All convs in this residual path are bias-free.

g.data-description: Conv2d 1×1. SE reduced width printed on stage; bias=True
g.text: SE reduced width printed on stage; bias=True

g.data-description: Elementwise multiply. Gate the original expanded feature

g.text: This channel gate preserves the spatial feature map.

g.data-description: FrozenBatchNorm2d. eps=0.00001; stored statistics in eval
ReLU or Hardswish. Hardswish(x) = x × clamp(x + 3, 0, 6) / 6

g.data-label: Choose a feature level per proposal

floor(4 + log2(sqrt(box area) / 224)); clip level range

g.aria-label: RoIAlign: scale box to feature coordinates
g.data-label: RoIAlign: scale box to feature coordinates
g.data-description: RoIAlign: scale box to feature coordinates. Aligned=False; bilinear samples; sampling_ratio=2
g.text: RoIAlign: scale box to feature coordinates

g.data-description: Average 2 × 2 samples in every bin. 7 × 7 bins for boxes; 14 × 14 bins for masks
g.text: 7 × 7 bins for boxes; 14 × 14 bins for masks
R is proposal count and N is final detection count.
These dimensions depend on image values, even at fixed input size.
MobileNet has two stride-32 maps; its RoI level range is 5...5.
N/S values for this shared MobileNet-FPN topology
